governing_instruments.title: Government of India Post-Matric Scholarship for SC Students Maharashtra Rules

decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category of Maharashtra.

decision_driving_rules.plain_en: Must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category
decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) category of Maharashtra.

decision_driving_rules.plain_en: Must be an enrolled student pursuing post-matric education
decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: The student must have passed Class 10 (SSC) and be enrolled in a recognized post-matric course.

decision_driving_rules.plain_en: Family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000
decision_driving_rules.verbatim_quote: Family annual income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 per annum.

exclusions.plain_en: Excludes SC students whose total family annual income exceeds Rs. 2,50,000
exclusions.verbatim_quote: Family annual income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000 per annum.

exclusions.plain_en: Only two boys from the same family are eligible; restriction does not apply to girls
exclusions.verbatim_quote: Only two boys from the same family are eligible, but this restriction does not apply to girls.
